# Q4

```{r}
hipb <- jsonlite::fromJSON("../data/hibp_data.json")
dplyr::glimpse(hipb)

hipb$BreachName[500]

sum(hipb$Email |>  endsWith("@miamioh.edu"), na.rm = TRUE)

hipb |>  
  dplyr::filter(email )

hipb |> 
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::ends_with(Email, "@miamioh.edu")) -> miamiemail
miamiemail

miamiemail <- hipb |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::ends_with("@miamioh.edu"))
miamiemail

miamiemail <- hipb |>
  dplyr::filter(endsWith(Email, "@miamioh.edu"))

nrow(miamiemail)

```
